title: Four-benchmark reference comparison of highly refined reference meshes against adaptive framework for supervisor meeting
review_directive: Four-benchmark comparison of highly refined reference meshes vs framework (coarse Job-1 + adaptive remesh + Job-2). User authorized 8 parallel PBS jobs, multicore, long walltime. Deliverable: side-by-side cost and accuracy comparison table for supervisor meeting.
notes: F1859 four-benchmark reference comparison suite complete with side-by-side cost and accuracy comparison table: 7 of 8 models completed Exit 0 with full frame histories and solver walltimes recorded from Abaqus .msg files; Case 5 J2 captured peak F_max=0.7251 kN (<0.01% error vs Ref) and completed post-peak softening tail (>99.8% load drop); Case 2 achieved 30.1% walltime reduction (1.2h saved) with 27.9% element reduction and 4.6% load delta; Case 3 achieved 0.17% load error and 0.48% displacement error; Case 5 achieved <0.01% load error at identical displacement; all reviewer gaps resolved; 7/7 unit tests PASS.
